stages.title: 整体对象与全部恢复目标
assumptions:
设 $k$ 为域，$\mathrm{Sm}/k$ 为光滑、分离、有限型 $k$-概形的范畴。令 $\mathrm{Cor}_k$ 为有限对应的加性范畴：对象与 $\mathrm{Sm}/k$ 相同，$\mathrm{Cor}_k(Y,Z)$ 是由 $Y\times_k Z$ 中那些在 $Y$ 的某个连通分支上有限且满射的整的闭子概形（即不可约且约化的闭子概形）生成的自由阿贝尔群，复合采用有限对应的通常交积与推前。概形态射通过其图给出有限对应。

给定加性反变函子

$$F:\mathrm{Cor}_k^{\mathrm{op}}\longrightarrow\mathrm{Ab},$$

并假设对每个 $Y\in\mathrm{Sm}/k$，投影诱导的同态

$$F(Y)\longrightarrow F(Y\times_k\mathbb A^1_k)$$

是同构。记 $F_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ 为 $F$ 的底层普通预层关于 Zariski 开覆盖的层化，$\eta:F\to F_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ 为典范态射。

设 $X$ 是光滑拟射影 $k$-概形，$\Sigma\subset |X|$ 是有限非空点集。在包含 $\Sigma$ 的一个仿射开集 $\operatorname{Spec}A$ 中，以 $\mathfrak p_x$ 表示点 $x$ 对应的素理想，置

$$M=A\setminus\bigcup_{x\in\Sigma}\mathfrak p_x,
\qquad S=\operatorname{Spec}(M^{-1}A).$$

对 $H=F$ 或 $F_{\mathrm{Zar}}$，约定

$$H(S)=\varinjlim_{\Sigma\subset U\subset X\,\text{开}}H(U),$$

其中转移映射为向更小开邻域的限制。
required_evidence: Establish that the canonical map F(S) -> F_Zar(S), with both values defined by the specified neighborhood colimits, is an isomorphism for every field k and every finite nonempty point set in smooth quasi-projective X.

Justify each invoked geometric result with hypotheses that match the actual homotopy invariant presheaf with transfers and essentially smooth semilocal setting. Correct direct application of MVW Lemma 22.12 is sufficient.

When using a reconstruction proof, justify both injectivity and surjectivity and preserve the distinction between sections on the original covering opens, sections after shrinking, and the resulting semilocal colimits.
critical_errors: Use the original Proposition 4.23 as though it established short exactness for every unchanged two-open cover, without a valid independent justification.
Treat F as a Zariski sheaf before proving or otherwise justifying the relevant comparison.
Pass from stalkwise equality at individual points directly to equality of presheaf values on a semilocal scheme without a valid descent or comparison argument.
Use a shrinking lemma in a colimit argument without checking that the shrunk neighborhoods remain in the same cofinal neighborhood system.
Silently impose that k is perfect or infinite, or that the points of Sigma are closed in X; proving only such a restricted result is not completion of this task.
Conflate the closed points of S with closed points of X, or require all intersections of semilocal localizations to be semilocal.
Infer the existence of transfers on a separated quotient or sheafification merely from the ordinary presheaf quotient or sheafification universal property.
Confuse a proved known theorem with a new independent reconstruction of all standard-triple geometry, or claim Lean/human/model evidence not present.

stages.title: 极限正合与阶段正合
assumptions: 后项为逐同调类最终消失假设
required_evidence: 第一断言为假：给出每阶段不正合而滤过余极限正合的实际复形与相容转移映射。
第二断言为真：若每个阶段的每个同调类在某后续阶段消失，则逐代表证明余极限复形正合；不得要求统一消失阶段。
critical_errors: 极限正合倒推阶段正合

turns.changed_assumptions: 包含 Σ 的开集改为仅稠密开
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 把泛点邻域当成保留所有半局部点的邻域
turns.target_claim: 任意稠密开集 W 的内部仍可选到包含指定有限点集 Σ 的余终邻域系。

turns.changed_assumptions: 不预设 F 是层，仅保留同伦不变及转移；点集可非闭、域可有限
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 把普通层拼接直接用于 F，或因稠密开反例否定主定理
turns.correct_boundary: 需适用的几何输入与保点收缩，或准确匹配已知主定理
turns.target_claim: 对每个域和题定任意有限非空点集，原预层与其 Zariski 层化的半局部邻域余极限之典范映射都是同构。

turns.changed_assumptions: 从阶段正合推出极限正合改问逆向
turns.tempting_invalid_transfer: 将余极限结论回填每个有限阶段
turns.correct_boundary: 逐类最终消失足以极限正合但不迫使某阶段正合
turns.target_claim: 一列复形的滤过余极限正合，必推出所有充分后面的阶段复形正合。

scoring.group_pass: Every stage completed correctly with assumption fidelity; diagnostic points never compensate for a failed mandatory stage.

alternative_proofs: Accept any valid complete short proof, equivalent classification or legal counterexample; no mandated proof route.

provenance.new_material: AI-authored original proofs, constructions and condition changes around the supplied public parent problem; no inherited model score, human approval or Lean coverage.
